name: Wavelength
tagline: Wavelength is a voice-to-diagram tool that turns calls, meetings, and transcripts into a living process map while you talk
description: Wavelength is a voice-to-diagram tool that turns calls, meetings, and transcripts into a living process map while you talk. Hold the mic or paste a transcript, describe the process in plain language, and the flow draws itself in real time. Solid arrows are confirmed, dashed amber ones are AI guesses you can confirm or fix in a click. What you can do - Map a process live on a call so everyone sees the same picture before the meeting ends - Edit three ways: an AI instruction, a right-click, or by
